reviews.title: Works great! Temps low!
reviews.comment: Keeps my i9 10900kf plenty cool. Its not the most silent AIO but for the price it outperforms some higher priced units.  Would recommend 👌
reviews.author: Kathy M.

reviews.title: Overall thoughts
reviews.comment: Very 👍 would buy again if I decide to build another pc. But I mean for 90 bucks it keeps everything cool and another upside would be the fans coming connected so you don’t have to daisy chain them. Everything is pretty well built and the guide was very well put together. I like the look of it but I wish it showed the temp on the pump. It’s very quiet and works well even though it has 3 fans.
reviews.author: Andrew Roncarati

reviews.title: Great cooler!
reviews.comment: Great cooler, easy Installation and configuration. Functions great! Cools amazing on my overclocked i7 11700k @ 5ghz
reviews.author: Eric Johnson

reviews.title: Please read the description before buying
reviews.comment: This AIO Cooler works pretty good. The value for money is great! The cooling is well performed. The instructions are decent, but easy to work with. The noise level is a little bit there but I can work with it. Cable management is okay. The main problem is I didn’t read the description since RGB it was for RGB 5v, so my motherboard didn’t have one but a RGB 12v port. So I had to get a SATA standalone RGB connector. But overall, It’s pretty good!
reviews.author: Orion chab

reviews.title: I love this cpu cooler
reviews.comment: Looks great, works great. I love it.
